item.title: COMMONS Lab
item.description: The COMMONS Lab develops computational metabolomics and knowledge-management approaches for natural products research. Within DBGI, the lab contributes workflows for sampling metadata, metabolomics data interpretation, linked open data, and reusable scientific knowledge.

item.title: Knowledge Representation Unit
item.description: The Knowledge Representation Unit contributes expertise in semantic web technologies, FAIR data, federated knowledge graphs, and AI-assisted exploration of structured scientific data. Within DBGI, the team supports knowledge-graph and interoperability workflows.

item.title: Laboratory of Functional Ecology
item.description:
Led by Professor Sergio Rasmann at the University of Neuchatel, the Laboratory of Functional Ecology investigates how plant chemical defences shape interactions among plants, herbivores, predators and parasitoids.

The group combines chemical ecology with phylogenetic, quantitative-genetic, phytochemical and behavioural approaches to study the evolution of plant defences, ecological interactions and diversification.

item.title: Plant Eco-Metabolomics Group
item.description: The Plant Eco-Metabolomics Group connects plant biodiversity, ecological interactions, and chemical diversity through metabolomics and bioinformatics. Within DBGI, PGEM contributes ecological framing, experimental design, and plant-metabolome expertise.

item.title: Pluskal Lab
item.description: The Pluskal Lab combines metabolomics, mass spectrometry, molecular networking, bioinformatics, and machine-learning approaches to study plant specialized metabolites. Within DBGI, the lab contributes analytical and computational expertise for profiling botanical collections.
